acceptedSourceFindings: All original body expressions/order/returns remain except the reviewed bounded observer insertions; original native guard and renderer_chunks clearing remain in place.
SECURITY INVOKER,volatility,search_path,owner/public ACL/ABI signatures remain; CREATE OR REPLACE only two pre-existing functions.
CAS binds natural assignedXID/PID/expected+new revisions/rawGUCs/roles and rejects exact projection-on. No manufactured OFF/NULL; no new Auth request or ACK/body return.
Only two scalar aggregate snapshots around text/join/chunk release/validation/JSONB cast. Exactly13/19 fields; bounded2048B per LOG, all records parsed/limited by L after EOF.
ACL before/selected/restore descriptor includes exact clone/database/logging/object/role/membership data, raw ACL NULL/order and ordinal expanded grantor/grantee/options.
Prepare compares exact qualified persisted before state; missing+NULL fails before grants. Grant targets are fixed two observer privileges only, never WITH GRANT OPTION.

Selected guard permits only exact minimal owner ACE additions with no grant option and otherwise identical metadata. Restore accepts original/that exact selected state, revokes only new missing-before bits, then requires complete original state equality before COMMIT.
additionalIntegrationRequirements: Before descriptor must be fully persisted and hash-bound before PREPARE can be invoked; passing a reconstructed guessed state is forbidden.

Finally restore must run exactly once after attempted preparation on success or error, while the owned DB remains available, before final catalog/strict stop. Unknown restoration blocks acceptance and preserves evidence.
L must qualify minimal selected raw state and restore raw state against persisted receipts, strict13/19 key/type/binder/byte/count matching against unchanged four accepted driver CAS calls.
Startup terse+fatal must be checked in actual readiness and same-CAS logs; all source/native/count/capture/history6000/shutdown guards remain in final actor.
methodLimitations: Net interval includes chunk release, unique/text-size checks, cast, SRF and LOG observer. Exclusive context bytes are not RSS/group peak or isolated representation ownership.
